meta.origin: Hand-curated from the institutions' own promotional pages and offer terms. No public API publishes account opening bonuses: they live on landing pages, are frequently targeted to individual customers or ZIP codes, and change weekly.
meta.note: Offline snapshot of real, recurring promotion styles at plausible levels for the stated date. Not a quote and not an offer. Every one of these must be confirmed on the institution's own page before you move money — the amount, the qualifying deposit and the holding period all move independently.

fieldNotes.bonus: The one-off cash payment, in dollars. For a percentage match this is the dollar figure at the requiredDeposit shown, and the row is marked scales:true.
fieldNotes.requiredDeposit: The dollar amount the offer actually requires you to bring: a minimum balance you must maintain, the qualifying deposits that must land, or the new money the tier is defined by. This is the money the annualised figure is measured against.
fieldNotes.holdDays: How long the money is committed from funding until the bonus is safely yours — the qualifying window plus any holding period plus the time the institution takes to pay.
fieldNotes.ongoingApy: What the account itself pays once the promotion is over. This is what is left if you leave the money there.
fieldNotes.depositBasis: balance_held means the money has to sit there; deposits_received means it only has to arrive and can be spent again, which makes the annualised figure conservative.
fieldNotes.scales: true only for percentage matches, which are proportional rather than capped. Everything else is a fixed dollar amount and is capped at the required deposit.

meta.userFileShape: Same shape as this file: {"items": [ ... ]}. An item whose id matches one here REPLACES it field by field; a new id is ADDED. Set dataAsOf on a row you refresh so the app trusts it more than the bundled snapshot.

items.name: Chase Total Checking new customer bonus
items.accessNotes: Open online with the current coupon code, or take it into a branch — Chase runs branch-only versions that are sometimes larger. Fund it, route one paycheck in, and leave it alone until the six months are up.
requirements: New Chase checking customers only — not available if you already hold a Chase personal checking account
One qualifying electronic direct deposit (payroll, pension or government benefit) within 90 days of opening
Account must stay open at least six months or Chase claws the bonus back
$12 monthly service fee unless a qualifying direct deposit lands, you keep $1,500 in the account, or you hold $5,000 across linked Chase accounts
Coupon code from the offer page must be presented at opening
items.notes: The $1,500 is the balance that waives the monthly fee, which is the money genuinely tied up here; the bonus itself is triggered by the direct deposit rather than by a minimum balance. If your paycheck waives the fee you can hold far less, and the return on what you actually park is then higher than shown.

items.name: Citi checking new money bonus, $10,000 tier
items.accessNotes: Open a Citi checking account online, enrol in the offer, then push new money in within the 20-day window and leave the balance untouched through the qualifying period.
requirements: New-to-Citi money only — funds already sitting at Citi do not count
Deposit within 20 days of opening and maintain the balance for 60 days
No Citi consumer deposit account closed within the last 180 days
Bonus paid roughly 30 days after the balance period ends
items.notes: Citi's bonus is a ladder rather than one offer, and the tiers are not proportional — the middle tiers have historically paid a better rate on the money than the largest one.

items.name: Citi checking new money bonus, $75,000 tier

requirements: New-to-Citi money only

items.name: Citi checking new money bonus, $300,000 tier
items.accessNotes: The top tier of the same ladder, sitting inside Citigold. Worth checking against a 3-month T-bill before committing: the bill pays more and is backed by the Treasury rather than by one bank.
items.aboveLimitNote: $300,000 in one bank is $50,000 above the FDIC limit for a single depositor in a single ownership category, and that excess is uninsured for the entire holding period. Splitting across ownership categories or banks fixes it; taking the risk for a $2,000 bonus does not.
requirements: New-to-Citi money only
Deposit within 20 days of opening and maintain the balance for 60 days
Citigold relationship tier applies at this deposit level
No Citi consumer deposit account closed within the last 180 days

items.name: SoFi Checking and Savings direct deposit bonus
items.accessNotes: Open online in minutes and point your payroll at it. This is one of the few here where the underlying account is worth keeping — but only while the direct deposit continues.

Bonus paid within a few days of qualifying
items.notes: The ongoing rate shown is the direct-deposit rate, not the base rate, so the account and the bonus have the same condition attached. SoFi extends coverage beyond the standard limit through a partner bank network, which is a program arrangement rather than a larger guarantee from any one bank.

items.name: Fidelity new account funding bonus
items.accessNotes: Open a Fidelity brokerage, cash management or Roth IRA online with the current promotion code and move $50 in. The bonus posts as cash within about 25 days.

items.notes: This is the clearest illustration in the app of why annualising a bonus can mislead. Doubling $50 is a genuine 200% return and it is also, in total, $100 that you can never earn again. Anyone reading the annualised figure as a rate has misunderstood the product.

items.accessNotes: Transfer an existing IRA in, keep the Gold subscription active, and do not touch the matched money for five years.
requirements: Robinhood Gold subscription required — on a $10,000 transfer the annual subscription fee eats a meaningful share of a one-off match

items.notes: The match is a percentage of what you transfer, so the dollar figure shown is what a $10,000 transfer earns and it scales with the amount. The five-year clawback is what actually decides whether this is worth doing: the money is not locked in the legal sense, but leaving early costs you the match.

items.name: Wealthfront Cash Account referral rate boost

items.notes: The only row here that is a rate uplift rather than a payment. The dollar figure is what a three-month boost is worth on $10,000, converted so it can be compared with the cash offers; it scales with the balance, which is why it is not marked as capped. Cash sits at partner banks and coverage runs well past the single-bank limit across the program, but it is pass-through coverage that depends on those banks and on accurate records.
